pages.title: Lord of the Herd
pages.text: Ruling over the secret pastures is the formidable $(6)Cow King$(0).$(br2)Wielding a giant executioner's halberd, the King commands lightning storms and executes devastating 360-degree whirlwind cleaves that shatter unarmored trespassers.

pages.title: Tactics & Spoils
pages.text: Keep your distance when the King charges electrical energy, and utilize ranged kiting or shields during whirlwind spins.$(br2)Upon defeat, the King yields massive experience, ancient sword relics, and the coveted $(b)Quantum Semiconductor$(0).
